scenarios.title: Find trusted pediatric heart help
scenarios.hook: A child in the extended family needs a pediatric cardiologist in Pune. You want a trusted path, not a random directory result.
scenarios.whyWow: The family network cannot solve the need directly, yet it can reach trusted local help without exposing the community directory.
scenarios.request: Could you connect us for guidance on a pediatric heart consultation?
scenarios.outcome: The specialist accepts the introduction. Identity is revealed only after consent.

scenarios.title: Reach an AI + PIM architecture expert
scenarios.hook: You need someone who has actually built enterprise PIM/MDM and AI architecture—not another generic AI profile.
scenarios.whyWow: A family member reaches highly specific professional expertise through alumni trust and a governed two-hop path.
scenarios.request: I am evaluating an AI-enabled PIM architecture and would value 20 minutes of practical guidance.
scenarios.outcome: A warm introduction reaches a verified architecture expert two networks away.

scenarios.title: Hire a senior frontend architect through trust
scenarios.hook: A founder needs a senior frontend architect in Pune and wants a warm referral rather than hundreds of cold applications.
scenarios.whyWow: The system finds a relevant professional opportunity but protects the candidate until they accept the introduction.
scenarios.request: We are hiring a principal-level frontend architect. Would you be open to a trusted conversation?
scenarios.outcome: The candidate consents before their identity is disclosed to the founder.

scenarios.title: Find an alumni mentor who walked the path
scenarios.hook: A younger alumnus wants to understand how someone from a similar background became a Principal Engineer.
scenarios.whyWow: The alumni network becomes a living mentorship utility rather than a static directory.
scenarios.request: Would you be willing to share how you navigated the path to principal engineering?
scenarios.outcome: A relevant senior alumnus accepts a mentoring introduction.

scenarios.title: Get trusted help while relocating to Pune
scenarios.hook: A family member is moving to Pune and needs trustworthy school, area and local-service guidance.
scenarios.whyWow: The product converts an extended family need into local trusted help without joining a public neighborhood group.
scenarios.request: We are moving to Pune next month. Could you help us shortlist areas and schools?
scenarios.outcome: A local community member opts in to help and becomes visible after consent.

scenarios.outcome: A trusted two-hop introduction reaches a finance expert without exposing the founders directory.
